description: The clip view of an arrangement's MIDI clip: a strip with its switch and name that rolls the view up, then Clip (start, end), Loop (switch, position, length, ÷2, ×2, Dupl. Loop), Groove (the swing, on the eighths or the sixteenths, and for a drum clip its steps or its roll), Scale (the clip's scale marked on the roll, Fit notes, and the keys the song's notes are likeliest in; on, transposing by one moves by its steps) and Notes (transpose, invert, reverse, legato, ×2, ÷2, humanize, velocity ramps) boxes, beside its piano roll (Draw, Fold, the loop brace on the ruler, keys, grid, a velocity or chance lane), or for a drum clip its steps, a row per pad. Notes are drawn a grid step at a time.
name: midi-clip-panel
